name: Counter-Strike: Global Offensive
author: 91701660+Marschux@users.noreply.github.com
description: Counter-Strike: Global Offensive dedicated server (app 740). Clients from the standalone CS:GO Legacy app 4465480 need the SourceMod plugins CSGOEngineFix and NoLobbyReservation on the server before they can join.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT=/mnt/server
mkdir -p "$ROOT/steamcmd" "$ROOT/steamapps"

echo "> Installing steamcmd ..."
curl -sSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xzf - -C "$ROOT/steamcmd"

echo "> Installing app ${SRCDS_APPID} ..."
export HOME="$ROOT"
(cd "$ROOT/steamcmd" && ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir "$ROOT" +login anonymous +app_update "${SRCDS_APPID}" validate +quit)

mkdir -p "$ROOT/.steam/sdk32" "$ROOT/.steam/sdk64"
cp -v "$ROOT/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so" "$ROOT/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so"
cp -v "$ROOT/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so" "$ROOT/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so"

# a place for own cvars; never overwritten, so a reinstall keeps it
if [[ ! -f "$ROOT/csgo/cfg/server.cfg" ]]; then
    echo "> Creating an empty server.cfg ..."
    mkdir -p "$ROOT/csgo/cfg"
    echo '// Own cvars go here, executed via the "Config to Execute" variable.' > "$ROOT/csgo/cfg/server.cfg"
fi

echo "> Done."

variables.name: Config to Execute
variables.description: Config in csgo/cfg executed at start.

variables.name: Additional Arguments
variables.description: Appended to the start command, for example -insecure or +sv_alltalk 1.

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: With game type 0: 0 Casual, 1 Competitive, 2 Wingman. With game type 1: 0 Arms Race, 1 Demolition, 2 Deathmatch.

variables.name: Game Type
variables.description: 0 Classic, 1 Gun Game, 2 Training, 3 Custom, 4 Cooperative, 5 Skirmish. Goes together with the game mode.

variables.name: Map Group
variables.description: Map rotation, e.g. mg_active, mg_bomb, mg_hostage.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Player slots.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Password for remote console. Empty means RCON off.

variables.name: Hostname
variables.description: The server name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: App ID
variables.description: Steam app of the dedicated server. 740 is CS:GO, do not confuse it with the standalone client app 4465480.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map loaded at start.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password players need to join. Empty means open.

variables.name: Game Server Login Token
variables.description: GSLT from steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers, created with app id 730. Without one the server stays off the public list.

variables.name: LAN Mode
variables.description: 1 keeps the server off the public list and skips Steam authentication.

variables.name: Region
variables.description: Server browser region: 0 US East, 1 US West, 2 South America, 3 Europe, 4 Asia, 5 Australia, 6 Middle East, 7 Africa, 255 World.

variables.name: Tickrate
variables.description: Server tickrate. 64 is the usual value, 128 costs noticeably more CPU.

variables.name: GOTV Delay
variables.description: Broadcast delay in seconds. 30 or more keeps spectators from spoiling the round.

variables.name: Enable GOTV
variables.description: 1 turns the spectator relay on. It needs its own port allocation.

variables.name: GOTV Max Clients
variables.description: How many spectators GOTV takes.

variables.name: GOTV Password
variables.description: Password for GOTV spectators. Empty means open.

variables.name: GOTV Port
variables.description: Port for GOTV. Needs an allocation on this server.
